tool_levels.lifecycle: load only the Person Thing and its complete lifecycle Event
tool_levels.processes: also load the nine unweighted IS process Events; every one of the thirteen 07r2 person scaffold requests selects this level

interval_convention.display: Resolved YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD life intervals name inclusive civil dates, not timestamps. YYYY/YYYY intervals retain year precision.
interval_convention.day_adapter: A resolved inclusive date interval is represented numerically as [start civil day, civil day after the displayed end). The adapter declares its epoch and day unit; the exclusive boundary is an accounting boundary, not an asserted time of birth or death.
interval_convention.year_adapter: A year-precision interval YYYY/YYYY maps to the coarse numeric scaffold envelope [start year, end year + 1). It does not locate an event within either endpoint year, license participation outside finer known lifecycle dates, or supply day-level duration weights.
interval_convention.authority: Finer dated source records govern day-level chronology; coarse compiler envelopes are structural compatibility projections. Unknown bounds remain tagged unknown rather than replaced with invented dates.

purpose: Open any person's lifecycle Event with the same first-run profile. The template supplies comparable questions and record locations; it does not assert a universal decomposition of human psychology.

attachment.requires: one Person Thing bound as subject of one complete lifecycle Event
attachment.structural_rule: Every instantiated process and scene-assessment Event occurs within the person's lifecycle. Perspective is derived from that ancestry; no holder or perspective field is copied onto every child.

life_event.interval: complete birth-to-death interval, or open end only for a living person
life_event.description: one coarse account of the whole life before periods or episodes are opened

periods.question: Which disjoint periods compose this lifecycle?
periods.children: four to eight disjoint period Events when the life is opened
periods.recomposition: period durations plus temporal remainder equal the lifecycle duration

is.relationship: nine concurrent Event-process views; they may overlap and do not sum

children.description: development, embodiment, physical capacity, disability, aging, mortality, and supported physical measurements

health.description: baseline capacity, illness or injury, treatment, recovery or consolidation, age-related change, and terminal transition
health.rule: Open only when health changes feasible action or another story-bearing process.

condition_cut.question: How is one unit of the person's current bodily health condition divided?
condition_cut.interpretation: The two principal children are opposite shares of one declared health condition. A 0.50/0.50 split is intermediate; 1.00/0.00 is the run's healthy reference and 0.00/1.00 its maximally ill reference. The remainder is retained when evidence does not justify a complete placement.

children.description: kinship, household, dependency, support, rupture, and restoration
the person's participation in separately identified joint relationship Events and their own readings of them
roles, projects, duties, institution memberships, work time, and work-derived income
residence, presence, workplace access, travel, and spatial constraints
money, assets, debt, credit, tools, discretionary time, capacity, and runway in declared real units
perception, belief, document access, learning, correction, and demonstrated capability
offices, memberships, publication, audiences, attributed recognition, and beliefs about recognition
constitutive wants, commitments, self-understanding, and sources of coherence

is.number_rule: No semantic number is stored on these nine process addresses. A number appears only on a separately declared Cut whose question supplies a comparison unit, such as attention across processes. Dates, money, counts, durations, locations, and physical measurements may appear as typed world data.

per_opened_want_cut.question_pattern: For this live AtomicWant, how is one unit of represented fulfillment outlook divided?

period_outlook_cut.question: How is one unit of this period's represented fulfillment outlook divided?

threat_character_cut.question: Conditional on one unit of represented threat-directed attention, how is it divided among the core wants containing the endpoints believed at risk?

core_want_outlook.refinement_rule: The period outlook is a coarse committed parent. When opened across active wants or disjoint shorter intervals, the weighted child mixture must recover it, with unsupported mass retained as remainder. The threat-character Cut may be derived from opened want and outlook Cuts or elicited coarsely, but it must reconcile when those children are opened.
core_want_outlook.time_rule: A selected scene may deviate from the period outlook. Recovery leaves the next period baseline substantially unchanged; consolidation changes it, with the intervening Events and an Understanding note explaining the transition.
core_want_outlook.interpretation: All values are sibling-relative shares under their named Cut questions. None is an absolute scale of fear, assurance, confidence, or personality.

what.opens_only_at: a selected scene or decision episode

concern_cut.question: How is one unit of this scene's motivational attention divided?

atomic_want_cut.question_pattern: Within {concern}, which desired registered endpoints organize attention?

what.outlook_rule: For each opened AtomicWant where fulfillment expectation matters, apply person_profile.core_want_outlook.per_opened_want_cut. Approach and avoidance, when represented, are strategies or action directions rather than fear poles.

appraisal_chain.rule: Concern, want, fulfillment outlook, threat belief, emotion, and action are never collapsed into one label. Threatened fulfillment is an outlook about a want. Fear is one possible appraisal of that outlook, not a concern or pole; the same threat may instead produce anger, sadness, or another emotion. If no active want is believed threatened, represented fear is zero. Any nonzero fear must link to a threatened AtomicWant or remain explicitly unresolved.

how.opens_only_at: a selected problem-solving or decision episode

module_cut.question: How is one unit of problem-solving attention divided in this scene?

framing_cut.question: Within framing, how is attention divided?

deciding_cut.question: Within deciding, how is attention divided?

how.strategy_rule: Specific strategies are linked Realizations or Events unless a separate bounded Cut question is deliberately asked.

feels.opens_only_at: a selected scene with a consequential appraisal

emotion_cut.question: How is one unit of represented emotional attention divided at this moment?

feels.rule: The Cut records composition, not absolute emotional intensity.

context.opens_only_at: a scene where the organization of action across contexts matters
context.cut_question: Through which mutually exclusive context allocation is action organized at this resolution?

direction.opens_only_at: a consequential choice or forecast boundary
direction.question: What could occur next at this evidence cutoff and horizon?
direction.rule: Sibling-relative forecast allocation unless separately calibrated as probability.

relationships_and_trust.world_record: one joint relationship Event with participant Bindings
relationships_and_trust.person_record: one directional reliance or belief Event-process under each person's lifecycle
relationships_and_trust.evidence: delegation, checking, fulfillment, breach, repair, withdrawal, communication, and action Events
relationships_and_trust.rule: No absolute trust score. A FEELS trust share is local emotion composition; a Direction Cut over fulfillment and breach is a separate forecast.

time_and_refinement.episode_profiles: duration-weighted mixtures over disjoint phases only
time_and_refinement.period_and_life_profiles: derived over authoritative disjoint temporal children with coverage and remainder reported
time_and_refinement.revision_rule: If opened children cannot reasonably explain the coarse parent, revise the parent and propagate the change.
